description:
An ATTRACTIVE THREE BEDROOM VICTORIAN TERRACE, with a SOUTH EASTERLY FACING GARDEN, SUPERB LOFT CONVERSION and STUNNING PRESENTATION throughout. IDEALLY LOCATED within the HEART OF THE FASHIONABLE DIDSBURY VILLAGE, with a wide range of shops, bars, and restaurants within easy reach, as well as the metro link station. Approx. Offered for sale with NO ONWARD CHAIN. 1,385 Sq.ft

The property is beautifully presented and consists of an inviting hallway with attractive tile flooring and traditional cornice features. 

To the front of the property is the bay fronted living room, featuring a decorative cast iron fireplace and high ceilings. Further down the hallway is the dining room, which is generously proportioned, creating a perfect space for entertaining and day-to-day family living, with patio doors opening directly onto south easterly facing garden.

The dining room flows seamlessly through to the stunning newly fitted kitchen, with high specification bespoke contemporary units complemented with Quooker Cube Hot, Cold and Sparkling water tap and integrated appliances

Stairs from the kitchen lead down to the unconverted lower ground floor, which is generously sized and provides an abundance of opportunity.

The first floor reveals two well-proportioned double bedrooms, the principal bedroom features high ceilings and benefits from bespoke built in wardrobes. The second double bedroom enjoys delightful views over the south easterly facing garden. 

The property is served by the beautifully appointed four-piece bathroom, featuring a Japanese Style Toilet, freestanding bath and walk in shower. 

Stairs from the landing rise to the wonderful loft conversion, which is occupied by a further spacious double bedroom with skylight and windows, bathing the room with natural light. 

The property is approached via an area of garden frontage, which is enclosed with a dwarf wall to the front and beautiful Victorian tiling leading to the front door. To the rear is the attractive landscaped South Easterly facing village garden, with a patio area providing an ideal space for outdoor entertaining in the warmer months.

Freehold  
Council Tax Band: D
Approx. 1,385 Sq.Ft
